verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Shopify POS runs on iOS and Android, offers Tap to Pay for contactless payments on a smartphone with no extra hardware, and sells hardware such as POS Hub. That makes quick in-person selling plausible, but nothing documents the onboarding flow or how long it takes. Missing for 10: documented sign-up and merchant/payments approval process, evidence of ordering hardware directly from the admin dashboard, any time-to-first-payment or shipping timeline, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a same-week launch.
